results.title: Pix of the Day, 5th November, 2026 - Across the world
results.content: Pix of the Day, 5th November, 2026 - Across the world

results.title: France: Up to 55,000 march in Lyon amid clashes and tear gas
results.content: Tens of thousands marched through Lyon area during a nationwide strike over wages and purchasing power. Police charged demonstrators and used tear gas as clashes erupted along the protest route.

results.title: James Barnor, who captured Ghana’s independence, wins top photography honour at 97
results.content: James Barnor, who photographed Ghana’s independence and Black life in 1960s London, will receive a top honour at the 2027 Sony World Photography Awards.

results.title: Egypt-US sign $625 framework agreement aimed at advancing mutual prosperity
results.content: Egypt and the United States signed a framework agreement on Wednesday aimed at advancing mutual prosperity. The US contributions could reach up to $625 million over five years.

results.title: Verdict expected in Tanzanian opposition leader's treason case
results.content: Tundu Lissu faces a treason charge carrying a possible death sentence as the High Court in Dar es Salaam is set to deliver its verdict on November 6

results.title: Political consultations ongoing in Israel to form new government
results.content: Consultations between Israeli President Isaac Herzog and political parties to form a new government in Israel are set to conclude on Thursday, more than a week after divisive general elections.

results.title: France: Mass protests and school blockades mark fourth national strike
results.content: Hundreds of thousands joined a fourth nationwide day of protests across France. Police used tear gas outside a Paris school, while major demonstrations disrupted Marseille and Nantes.

results.title: El-Sayed victory draws mixed response in Egypt over criticism of Cairo
results.content: Abdul El-Sayed made history on Tuesday, becoming the first Muslim ever elected to the United States Senate. The Michigan Democrat is of Egyptian descent but Egypt state media has largely ignored his win after his criticism of the Egyptian government.

results.title: JD Vance distances himself from Trump and Iran war after US midterms debacle
results.content: United States Vice-President JD Vance distanced himself from Donald Trump's defence of the Iran war after the Republican party's debacle in the midterm elections.

results.title: Who benefits more from the Russia - Africa partnership? (Africanews Debates )
results.content: Russia's growing influence in Africa is raising questions about whether its partnerships are delivering real economic benefits, as analysts debate the balance between Moscow's political ambitions and African countries' development needs.

results.title: Nearly 3,000 people find shelter in a former school in Haiti
results.content: In Port-au-Prince, a school that once welcomed hundreds of pupils is now home to nearly 3,000 people displaced by violence.

results.title: Iran: Flames engulf banner depicting US and Israeli leaders
results.content: Demonstrators in Tehran burned a banner depicting US and Israeli leaders during rallies marking the 1979 US embassy takeover. The protests followed a major electoral setback for Donald Trump.

results.title: Nigeria's Dangote looks to expand IPO access to exchanges across Africa
results.content: After launching Africa’s biggest IPO in September, Nigeria’s Dangote Group is looking to make shares in its Lagos refinery available through more African stock exchanges.

results.title: El-Sayed’s Senate win breaks barriers for Arab Americans in Michigan
results.content: Muslim voters, who make up only about 2% of voters in Michigan, overwhelmingly voted for El-Sayed.

results.title: Ukraine: Russian drone and missile attack sparks fire in Kyiv region
results.content: A Russian strike on a logistics facility in Sofiivska Borshchahivka, in the Kyiv region, injured one man and sparked a major fire, with emergency crews battling the flames following an overnight attack involving 128 drones and two missiles.

results.title: Morocco say it remains committed to Western Sahara ceasefire as peacekeeping mission ends
results.content: Morocco says it remains committed to the ceasefire in Western Sahara even in the absence United Nations peacekeepers. Last week, the UN Security Council failed to agree on an extension of the 35-year-old mission after the US and Russia each vetoed competing resolutions.

results.title: Jesús Owono speaks of “immense pain” after Jesús de Miguel’s death
results.content: Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono expressed his grief on Wednesday, November 4, following the death of Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel.

results.title: Gaza: Displaced Palestinian builds wind turbine to generate electricity
results.content: A displaced Palestinian in Gaza has built a makeshift wind turbine to bring electricity to tents in Khan Younis. Unable to afford solar panels, he has found a way to harness the wind to power everyday essentials.

results.title: New Zealand: Dead whales found as rescuers battle mass stranding
results.content: Volunteers in New Zealand are working to save pilot whales stranded along the Wairarapa coast, near Cape Palliser. At least 14 have been helped back into the water, but many others have died along the remote coastline.

results.title: Iranians hold anti-U.S. and anti-Israel rallies across the country
results.content: Iranians held anti-U.S. and anti-Israel rallies across the country on Wednesday, marking the National Day of Fighting Global Arrogance and denouncing what they call U.S.-Israeli hegemony.

results.title: Seven decades behind the lens: Ghana's James Barnor receives top photography honour
results.content: From his studio in Accra to the pages of "Drum" magazine, Barnor documented everyday life and Black culture during a period of profound social change.

results.title: Vote counting gets underway in critical South Africa local elections
results.content: Counting would start at polling stations soon after the last votes had been cast, with final results due by Sunday, the election authority said.

results.title: Spain: Madrid hosts 30th Ibero-American Summit with 22-nation bloc
results.content: Spain is hosting the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid, bringing together leaders from Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking nations. The gathering aims to strengthen cooperation across Europe and Latin America.

results.title: Chadian president meets Algerian foreign minister in Ndjamena
results.content: Observers say Algeria, which this week deployed troops to Niger seeks to regain influence in the Sahel. Chad and Niger share a border

results.title: WHO approves clinical trials on two new Ebola vaccines
results.content: The World Health Organization on Wednesday approved clinical trials for two new Ebola vaccines, as doctors fight to control an outbreak in Africa that has killed more than 5,300 people

results.title: Libya's eastern administration appoints a new central bank governor
results.content: The former governor, Naji Issa, submitted his resignation to the two legislative chambers in August without publicly explaining his reasons.

results.title: Brazil: Santa Claus School celebrates graduation at Christ the Redeemer
results.content: Dozens of Santas gathered at Rio de Janeiro's iconic Christ the Redeemer statue to celebrate their graduation. The 55 new recruits are preparing to spread Christmas cheer across Brazil.

results.title: Iran's leaders say midterm results show voters have rejected Trump's war
results.content: Iranians on Wednesday struck a defiant tone, celebrating U.S. voters’ rebuke of President Donald Trump in the midterm elections while many in the Middle East waited to see how the results could affect the Iran war

results.title: UK: Police arrest Palestine Action supporters outside Supreme Court
results.content: Police arrested supporters of Palestine Action outside the Supreme Court in London, United Kingdom, on Wednesday 4 November, as a legal battle over the British government's ban on the group resumed.

results.title: Global travel could hit record levels despite wars and rising fuel costs
results.content: The World Travel Market global report says tourists are likely to spend 23.9 billion nights on vacation in 2026, with total visitor spending of $7.8 trillion.
